metaTitle: Custom Cork Coffee Mugs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cork coffee mugs for your brand. Durable ceramic mugs with a natural cork base. Perfect for corporate gifts and events.
introHtml: Cork coffee mugs combine the warmth of ceramic with a natural cork base that protects desks and tables from scratches and condensation. The cork also provides a comfortable, non-slip grip. Ideal for corporate gift sets or coffee shop promotions, these mugs can be imprinted with your logo using screen printing or full-color wraps. Choose from 14 oz or 15 oz sizes for a substantial feel that stands out from standard ceramic mugs.
heroAltText: Custom cork coffee mugs with ceramic body and natural cork base on a wooden desk
